title: Google 推出全新"实验性"AI 游戏平台 Google Playground
content:
Google Playground is an 'experimental' AI game platform
Business
PC
Mobile
News
Google debuts new 'experimental' AI game platform named Google Playground
A platform for people who want to play games made by AI.
Bryant Francis
,
Senior Editor
,
GameDeveloper.com
October 6, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
Image via Google
Google is making
another big swing
at building a dedicated video game platform—this time opting to produce one for games made with generative AI. The new venture, Google Playground, is a platform for making, sharing, and playing games made using generative AI tools.
In today's announcement, a Google spokesperson described Playground as an "experimental gaming platform" that "Lets users create, play and share fully custom games with no coding experience required.
"With Playground’s conversational interface, users can create custom games by typing what they want, remixing starter prompts or getting guided support to help them share their creativity with the world," the company stated. "Essentially acting as a director, users can refine the rules with prompts, customize characters and tweak the environment until it’s what they envision. And since Playground is browser-based, games are playable across phones and laptops."
Related:
Undead Labs studio head says they were 'irresponsibly transparent' in preparing staff for layoffs
Developers interested in experimenting with Playground can also take advantage of
Unity Spark
, a new, separately-announced tool from Unity built to work with Playground.
Google's new platform appears targeted to both veteran game developers and would-be game-makers who want to turn their ideas into games without going through the traditional development process. This comes as developers continue to
experiment with generative AI
, but do so with
grave concerns
about its impact on the video game industry.
Those curious about Google's new platform can try the games for themselves
here
.
